Second independent check. Is this M12 code-review finding a REAL, actionable bug/issue that should be fixed before merge? Read the code yourself. Be skeptical — confirm only if you can point to the concrete problem in the diff.

Lens: a11y
File: components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx (saveReschedule(), line 55: announce(t("account.nextSession")))
Title: Reschedule success announces a meaningless label fragment to screen readers
Detail: After a successful reschedule the live region announces t("account.nextSession") which resolves to the bare string "Next session" (messages/en.json:362) — a UI label, not a confirmation of what just happened. The reschedule panel also closes (setRescheduleId(null)) and the inputs clear with no visible/announced success state, so a screen-reader user gets no meaningful feedback that the reschedule succeeded. Compare the cancel path on the same component (lines 35-38) which correctly announces a dedicated confirmation message. This is a live-region/feedback gap introduced by this diff.

content.text:
The finding is confirmed. I have everything I need.

The evidence is concrete:

1. **`components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx:55`** — after a successful reschedule, `announce(t("account.nextSession"))` is called.

2. **`messages/en.json:362`** — `"account.nextSession"` resolves to the bare string `"Next session"`, which is a UI label (used as a dashboard section heading), not a confirmation of the action that just happened. A screen-reader user hears "Next session" with no indication that their reschedule succeeded.

3. **Contrast with the cancel path** in the same file (lines 35-38), which correctly announces a dedicated, meaningful confirmation: `t("account.cancelledRefund")` / `t("account.cancelledCharged")` ("Cancelled — your hold was released." / "Cancelled — the block was charged per the cancellation policy.").

4. The reschedule panel closes (`setRescheduleId(null)`) and the input clears (`setNewTime("")`) on success, so there is no other visible or announced success state — the live-region announcement is the only feedback, and it's meaningless.

5. There is no dedicated reschedule-success message key in `messages/en.json` (the reschedule keys are only `reschedule`, `rescheduleHeading`, `rescheduleSave`), confirming the right fix is to add a proper confirmation message rather than reuse an unrelated label.

This is a real, actionable a11y feedback gap introduced by the diff. It's a genuine inconsistency (cancel does it right, reschedule doesn't), the fix is well-scoped (add a confirmation string and announce it, ideally with the assertive flag), and it directly harms the screen-reader experience the project treats as non-negotiable.

input.reason: Confirmed real a11y bug. In components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx, saveReschedule() at line 55 calls announce(t("account.nextSession")) on success. That key (messages/en.json:362) resolves to the bare label "Next session" — a dashboard section heading, not a confirmation of what just happened. On success the panel also closes (setRescheduleId(null)) and the input clears (setNewTime("")), so this live-region announcement is the ONLY feedback a screen-reader user gets, and it is meaningless. This directly contrasts with the cancel path in the same component (lines 35-38), which correctly announces dedicated confirmations (account.cancelledRefund / account.cancelledCharged, "Cancelled — your hold was released." etc.). No dedicated reschedule-success message key exists in en.json (only reschedule/rescheduleHeading/rescheduleSave), confirming the wrong string was reused. The announce signature (components/ui/Toast.tsx:48) also takes an assertive flag the cancel path uses (true) but reschedule omits. Fix is well-scoped: add a proper reschedule-confirmation string and announce it (assertive). Given the project's non-negotiable WCAG stance, this should be fixed before merge.
